exercises.question: How much heat is required to raise the temperature of 2 kg of water by 5°C? (c = 4200 J/kg°C).
exercises.question_amharic: የ 2 ኪ.ግ ውሃን የሙቀት መጠን በ 5°C ለማሳደግ ምን ያህል ሙቀት ያስፈልጋል? (c = 4200 J/kg°C)።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation: 1. Identify m = 2 kg, ΔT = 5°C, c = 4200 J/kg°C.\n2. Apply Q = 2 * 4200 * 5.\n3. Q = 10 * 4200 = 42,000 Joules.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic: 1. Identify m = 2 kg, ΔT = 5°C, c = 4200 J/kg°C.\n2. Apply Q = 2 * 4200 * 5.\n3. Q = 10 * 4200 = 42,000 Joules.
